text:
Maya R. (CSM): Heads up: Wireless Division renewal — procurement is asking to split the $120,000 invoice 60/40 across two legal entities. They also want the PO to reference the new SOW number. CFO needs the tax ID on the quote before PO. Can we have this sorted before EOW? cc @Ravi K.

Ravi K. (AE): Thanks Maya — noted. Did procurement send the vendor codes for both entities?

Jordan P. (Procurement): I have both vendor codes: WIRE-EU-01 and WIRE-US-02. They want split lines on the invoice. Quick Q: can we issue 2 separate invoices or one invoice with two line items and two remit addresses?

Lena S. (Finance): Prefer two invoices to keep AR clean. We also need the tax form (W-9 equivalent) for the US entity. If they want net30 we need to confirm payment terms.

Maya R. (CSM): Wireless prefers net30 for the 40% US portion, EU entity wants 30 days too but will pay via SEPA. Also they requested a 9-month term instead of 12 — that changes pricing and proration. Need an updated quote.

Ravi K. (AE): We can generate a prorated 9mo quote. Jordan — can you confirm the effective date? I'll loop in Pricing.

Jordan P. (Procurement): Effective date from their contract: 2026-05-01. PO target by 2026-04-22.

SageBot (billing-bot): Automated note: To issue multiple invoices, CSM must set the 'split_billing_entities' flag on the account. Run: `/billing set split true account:wireless-division`

Maya R. (CSM): Running that now. Procurement also asked to include a training credit line on the invoice (2 onboarding seats). I'll add a line: "Onboarding training — 2 seats — $3,000"

Lena S. (Finance): Confirming accounting can accept the training as a separate line item. Also send the W-9 to finance@redwood.com when you receive it.

Ravi K. (AE): I'll get the pricing update with tax ID fields populated and circulate the revised quote by EOD today. @Jordan, can you confirm vendor billing emails for both entities?

Jordan P. (Procurement): Confirmed: wire-eu@billing.wireless.com and accounts-payable@wireless-us.com. PO to be routed to contracts@wireless.com.

Maya R. (CSM): Thanks all. Plan: issue two invoices, updated quote with tax IDs and prorated 9mo pricing. If PO is delayed, fallback is CC payment for the first invoice to unblock onboarding. Agree?

Lena S. (Finance): :thumbsup: We can accept CC as a fallback but need card authorization on file and a signed agreement.

Maya R. (CSM): I'll follow up with the customer and update this thread. Will post the updated quote once Ravi shares it. ETA latest 2026-04-22.
